Soldiers should sleep as much as they can, whenever they can, as the situation allows.
The vast majority of Soldiers require 7 -8 hours of sleep per night to sustain
performance; more sleep is better. Soldiers can maximize sleep and subsequent
performance by timing sleep and caffeine use optimally. Finally, only sleep replaces
lost sleep.
